name: MQTT-Camera-AI-Monitor
description: Monitor MQTT channels for trigger commands, captures high-quality images from RTSP cameras using FFmpeg, and processes them through OpenAI-compatible AI endpoints for analysis. The application supports both single and multi-image capture for advanced motion detection and temporal analysis.
